name: Anchored Spell (Metamagic)
body:
Use your blood to maintain a limited number of effects permanently.

Benefit(s): An anchored spell can be placed on a location, remaining indefinitely. This feat cannot be applied to spells which target creatures or objects, have a range of personal, or are instantaneous.

The anchored spell requires leaving a rune drawn in blood within the area. In order to function, the rune cannot be hidden or concealed even by illusion magics. The rune can be found and disabled as a magical trap, with a DC of 25 + the base spell level. Otherwise, the spell is treated as though affected by permanency.

You can maintain a number of anchored spells equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1). If you exceed that limit, choose one of your anchored spells to be dismissed as a free action.

If the spell has an expensive material component, casting an anchored version of that spell requires 25 times the amount of material components.

An anchored spell uses up a spell slot three levels higher than the spell’s actual level.
